subject: Bellevue Pond Rehabilitation Project
overview: The Medford Conservation Commission approved a Certificate of Compliance for an Eversource transmission line project and issued an Order of Conditions with special stipulations for DCR's Bellevue Pond Rehabilitation Project.

items.title: Certificate of Compliance: Eversource Transmission Line (DEP File #2015-0210)
items.summary: Approved a complete Certificate of Compliance for Eversource following review of stamped as-built drawings and site restoration photographs.

items.title: Notice of Intent: Bellevue Pond Rehabilitation Project (DEP File #215-0245)
items.summary: Approved an Order of Conditions with special conditions for dam repair and erosion control in the Middlesex Fells, requiring submittals for water control, compensatory tree plantings, and field-adjusted protection for native vegetation.
